title: Breadth-first search — Graph Traversal Engine
description: BFS explores in waves from the start, guaranteeing shortest-path discovery in unweighted graphs. A queue plus a visited set implements it in O(V + E). BFS answers 'how many hops apart'.

title: Depth-first search — Graph Traversal Engine
description: DFS plunges down each branch before backtracking, using a stack. It finds paths with minimal memory but no shortest-path guarantee. DFS suits exhaustive exploration.
provenance: Public methodology — standard computer-science technique documented in the technical literature; fact-checked 2026-10-21.

title: Shortest paths (Dijkstra) — Graph Traversal Engine
description: Dijkstra's algorithm extends BFS to weighted edges with a priority queue. It settles nodes in order of true shortest distance. Dijkstra routes everything from road networks to dependency costs.

title: Depth-limited search — Graph Traversal Engine
